analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear, focusing on ethical leather and a unique heirloom product. The ‘material passport’ and aging test are good attempts at transparency, but require robust execution to be truly impactful.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Identifies key risks (cell loss, texture variability) and proposes mitigation strategies, demonstrating some risk awareness.
